title: C/Zephyr: structured log fields discipline
description: C impl uses Zephyr LOG_ERR/LOG_WRN/LOG_DBG with printf-style strings. No key-value discipline. Zephyr logging v2 supports dictionary mode (CONFIG_LOG_BACKEND_DICT) for binary key-value pairs. Fix: (1) define LOG field naming convention (pkt_id, sender_iid, layer, errno), (2) add LOG_DBG at pipeline entry/exit in lora_l2_rx.c, lichen_l2_rx.c, schc, router dispatch, (3) evaluate dictionary backend for CI test runs. Gate verbose logging behind CONFIG_LICHEN_DIAG_VERBOSE.
notes: Emit logfmt via existing Zephyr LOG macros: LOG_DBG pkt_id=%u event=rx_stage len=%u rssi=%d. No heap allocation. For native_sim CI: evaluate dictionary backend post-processed to JSONL. Gate verbose logging behind CONFIG_LICHEN_DIAG_VERBOSE. Standard field names per spec/10-implementation.md section 16.8.
